scripts.test:e2e: pnpm build && pnpm exec playwright test
scripts.test:e2e-agent: pnpm build && pnpm --filter actor-kit-chat-example build && E2E_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 pnpm --filter @actor-kit/e2e-agent test:e2e
scripts.record:studio: pnpm build && pnpm --filter actor-kit-chat-example build && node scripts/record-studio-walkthrough.mts
scripts.lint: biome check packages/core/src/ packages/worker/src/ packages/client/src/ packages/react/src/ packages/test/src/ packages/studio/src/ tests/ scripts/
scripts.lint:fix: biome check --write packages/core/src/ packages/worker/src/ packages/client/src/ packages/react/src/ packages/test/src/ packages/studio/src/ tests/ scripts/
